theme: An open Orlando day — one booking worth doing early.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. You're at the villa with the girls in Orlando and the calendar is wide open until Julia's birthday at five. The one thing genuinely worth doing today is locking a rental before it sells out.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 travel task has been overdue since Sept 14. Reserve a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week now — the Pathfinder is south until late May, and holiday PWM inventory is thin and sells out.

recipe.title: White sweet potato soup with pickled scallions

acts.line: The calendar is empty until evening, so the whole morning is yours to spend as you like.
A villa day in Orlando with the four girls, Disney now two days out on Saturday.
Julia's birthday sits at five — a quiet reminder on the calendar, nothing that needs planning.
